Chapter 4, Proving Systems, First Edition, 1978 (ANSI/API MPMS 4-1978) This publication serves as a guide for the design, installation, calibration, and operation of meter proving systems. All types of proving systems in general use by the petroleum industry are covered, including field standards, pipe provers, tank provers, and master meter provers. Meter proving and analysis of sphere position repeatability are also included, along with 18 detailed illustrations. 49 pages.

Price each, $8.00
